title: The Passage of the Upper Fly River
author: August Okonkwo
blurb: Ulyana Okafor, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
